note: Golden retrieval set for `fxlla kb eval`. The corpus is this repository's own documentation: real technical prose about distinct topics, no invented fixtures and no network. Queries are phrased as a person would ask them rather than as keyword lookups, so they exercise the embedding rather than string overlap. `expect` lists every file that legitimately answers the query; a hit is any of them appearing in the top k. CHANGELOG.md and docs/JOURNAL.md are deliberately NOT in the corpus: they are append-only logs, they are where eval results get written down, and including them made every recorded score go stale the moment the result was recorded - the first run of this set scored nomic at 67% recall@1, and writing that number into those two files moved it to 56%. The corpus still shifts when the remaining docs are edited, which is what the fingerprint in the output is for: two runs are comparable only if it matches.
